The lighting, shadows, and object boundaries are coherent (supported by Topology Auditor). The only notable artifacts are minor textural inconsistencies (waxy sheen on plums) typical of AI generation, rated at severity 1. The 'semantic failure' is treated as an alignment defect rather than a geometric artifact like melting or fusion, allowing the artifact score to reflect the high technical quality of the rendering despite the wrong subject.
